releaseNotes:
• Background Screen-Off Timer Stop & Auto-Reset: 30-minute continuous screen timer and 5-minute rest timer cleanly stop after 5m of screen-off in background without accumulating hours of background usage
• PowerManager Integration: Verifies interactive screen state to prevent phantom session starts while phone is asleep
• AlarmManager Deep Sleep Expiry: Wakes reliably in background after 5m screen-off to complete break and reset timers
• Break Completion UI: Proper completion message on Break Alert screen with 00:00 session reset on continue
